purpose.description: Default unspecified. Restricted model weights require non-commercial research here or in the model settings.

publication.description: Default strict. single_writer requires local output and external unique-run/single-writer ownership.

resolution.description: Defaults applied, pending or resolved input facts and their provenance.

description: Structural schema of a resolved generic configuration. Simple input expands to this form; load_config additionally enforces UTC intervals, lineage, physical work uniqueness, dependencies, method-specific support, restricted-model purpose and evidence bindings. resolution.status pending appears only in offline expansions of simple input.

sentinels.description: Finite values rejected (raw retained); never implied by 9999/-9999.

qc_accept.description: Accepted QC codes; required with qc_column.

family.description: Descriptive only; never a cadence or preparation rule.

format.description: Local .parquet is inferred; explicit format persists for extensionless snapshots. Remote Parquet is unsupported.
